purpose: Separate permanent architecture layers, chronological development phases, audit/debug cycles, work packages, and concrete artifact versions so that changing a frozen layer artifact never implies reopening a completed development phase.

architecture_layers.name: Acquisition
architecture_layers.responsibility: Provider acquisition, provider-native parameter and run/grid identity, availability observation, source evidence and transfer preparation.

architecture_layers.name: Persistence
architecture_layers.responsibility: Verified transfer, immutable/revision-aware persistence, Parquet/DuckDB schemas, causal as_of views, ensemble atomicity and archive interfaces.

architecture_layers.name: Analysis
architecture_layers.responsibility: Meteorology Feature Broker, entity-specific meteorological analysis, calibration, uncertainty, derived features and analysis result persistence. No operational go/no-go authority.

architecture_layers.name: Decision
architecture_layers.responsibility: Hazard, opportunity, evidence and window decision policy, safety gates, decision-state composition and operational authorization semantics.

architecture_layers.name: Delivery
architecture_layers.responsibility: Notifications, scheduled reports, UI/presentation, deduplication and delivery policy.

layer_rules: Layer identifiers are permanent architecture identifiers and are never used as chronological project phases.
A development phase may create or supersede artifacts in more than one architecture layer when required by its scoped objective.
A frozen artifact is never edited in place; a change is implemented as a new artifact version with explicit supersedes lineage.
A downstream discovery may require a new upstream artifact version without reopening the development phase in which the predecessor was created.

development_phase_model.meaning: Chronological project-development interval with explicit scope and exit gate. DEV numbers do not identify architecture layers.

current_mapping.scope: Acquisition hardening, causal persistence/storage foundation and freeze
Build the L3 meteorological analysis layer and its stable input/output contracts. It may introduce versioned L1/L2 successors required by L3, but must not change L4/L5 operational authority.

development_phase_model.future_rule: Assign DEV-04 and later only when their scopes are explicitly approved. Do not infer DEV number from target layer number.

work_package_model.rule: Work packages belong to exactly one development phase, may list affected architecture layers, and have explicit dependencies, status and exit gate.

audit_model.rule: Audit/debug cycles are orthogonal to development phases. Never label a repair sequence as a project phase.

artifact_version_model.rule: Artifact version numbers are local to the artifact and have no relationship to DEV numbers or layer numbers.

forbidden_for_new_work: bare 'Phase 1', 'Phase 2' or 'Phase 3' without a legacy/history qualifier
using audit repair letters/numbers as development phases
using an artifact major version as a project phase identifier

legacy_policy.rule: Historical names and evidence paths remain unchanged for reproducibility. New documents must expose a canonical ID and may retain legacy_aliases for searchability.

known_ambiguous_aliases.canonical_class: historical storage migration cycle; not DEV-03
